card.line: Heshbon was the city of Sihon, king of the Amorites, which Israel captured and the tribe of Reuben later rebuilt.

moments.title: Israel captures Heshbon
moments.text: After Israel defeated Sihon in battle, they captured all the cities of the Amorites and lived in them, including Heshbon and its villages. Heshbon was Sihon's city.

moments.title: Reubenites rebuild Heshbon
moments.text: Moses gave Sihon's kingdom to Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh. The Reubenites then built up Heshbon and other cities.
